name: Call cancelled
description: A closing call is cancelled (not rescheduled: a reschedule moves the appointment and never fires this). Both pipeline cards move to their cancelled stage, the appointment date comes off the contact, the closer gets a rebook task due in a day, stat-cancelled replaces the booked tags, and the team gets a Slack note with who cancelled and why.

nodes.body: Cancelled by {{appointment.cancelled_by | default:the invitee}}. Reason: {{appointment.cancel_reason | default:none given}}.
